data.title: 椎叶紬 · 借来的伞
data.description: 雨来得突然，紬站在屋檐下整理刚借到的伞。她伸手试了试雨势，确认伞面撑开后才准备出发。
data.action: opening an umbrella beneath an awning
data.promptProse: Sheltered beneath the colorful striped canvas awning of a corner bakery, Tsumugi unfurls a bright yellow borrowed umbrella, pausing on the threshold to watch the rain slacken. Puddles on the stone sidewalk shimmer with vibrant reflections of storefront neon and flower shop displays, while fresh rain droplets fall from the awning onto the glistening pavement.
